_A_INPUT_OTP_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The AInputOtp component enters a one-time code (OTP), for example a confirmation code from an SMS or an authenticator app. Every character has its own cell, the model is a string.
_A_INPUT_OTP_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION_:
Accessibility: the cells are a group (role="group") named by the label, every cell has the name «Character 1 of 6». Help text and errors are connected with aria-describedby. The first cell has autocomplete="one-time-code", so the browser can fill in a code from an SMS, the code is spread over all cells.

  • A typed character moves the focus to the next cell.
  • Backspace: deletes the character, in an empty cell the character of the previous cell.
  • Delete: deletes the character of the cell.
  • Arrow left/right, Home, End: move between the cells.
  • Pasted text is spread over the cells, a whole code always from the first cell. Characters that are not allowed are skipped.
_A_INPUT_OTP_EXAMPLE_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_: We sent the code to your phone
_A_INPUT_OTP_EXAMPLE_HELP_TEXT_: The code is valid for 10 minutes
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_LENGTH_DESCRIPTION_: length sets the number of cells (default 6).
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_CHAR_TYPE_DESCRIPTION: char-type: numeric (default, digits and the numeric keyboard), alphanumeric (letters and digits) or any (all characters except spaces). is-uppercase converts letters to upper case.
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_VALIDATOR_DESCRIPTION: validator is called for every character with { char, index } and returns true if the character is allowed. It replaces char-type. inputmode chooses the keyboard on mobile devices.
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_SIZE_DESCRIPTION_: size: small, default or large. The sizes also follow the density (data-a-density).
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_MASK_DESCRIPTION_: With mask the characters are hidden (type="password"). placeholder is shown in every empty cell.
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_SEPARATOR_DESCRIPTION: separator is a string between all cells or a function ({ index }) => string for the gap after the cell with the index, an empty string shows no separator. The slot separator gets { index }. Separators are hidden from screen readers.
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_FINISH_DESCRIPTION_: The event finish is emitted when all cells are filled. The example accepts the code 246810. For another code it shows an error, clears the field and moves the focus to the first cell with the method focus.
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_HELP_TEXT_DESCRIPTION: help-text and label-description are connected to the group and the cells with aria-describedby.
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_ERRORS_DESCRIPTION_: errors shows the error text, marks all cells and sets aria-invalid.
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_DISABLED_DESCRIPTION_: disabled disables all cells. readonly shows the value as text, with mask it shows readonly-mask-symbol for every character.
_A_INPUT_OTP_GROUP_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: In AForm and AGroup the component is used with type: "otp".
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_AUTOCOMPLETE_DESCRIPT: Value of autocomplete of the first cell. one-time-code lets the browser fill in a code from an SMS.
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_CHAR_TYPE_DESCRIPTION: Allowed characters: numeric, alphanumeric or any (without spaces).
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_INPUTMODE_DESCRIPTION: Keyboard on mobile devices (inputmode of the cells). By default numeric for char-type numeric, otherwise text.
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_PLACEHOLDER_DESCRIPTI: Character that is shown in every empty cell.
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_READONLY_MASK_SYMBOL_: Symbol that is shown in read-only mode for every character if mask is set.
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_SEPARATOR_DESCRIPTION: Separator between the cells: a string or a function ({ index }) => string.
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_SIZE_DESCRIPTION_: Size of the cells: small or large.
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_TYPE_DESCRIPTION_: Type of the form element. Used by AForm to choose the component.
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_VALIDATOR_DESCRIPTION: Function ({ char, index }) => Boolean that checks every character. Replaces char-type.
_A_INPUT_OTP_PROPS_VARIANT_DESCRIPTION_: Look of the cells: outlined, filled or underlined.
_A_INPUT_OTP_EVENTS_FINISH_DESCRIPTION_: Emitted when all cells are filled. Payload: { model }.
_A_INPUT_OTP_EVENTS_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION_: Emitted when the focus moves into the component (not when it moves between the cells).
_A_INPUT_OTP_EVENTS_BLUR_DESCRIPTION_: Emitted when the focus leaves the component.
_A_INPUT_OTP_SLOTS_SEPARATOR_DESCRIPTION: Content of the separator after the cell with the index. Slot props: { index }.
_A_INPUT_OTP_METHODS_FOCUS_DESCRIPTION_: focus({ index }) focuses the cell with the index, without an index the first empty cell.
_A_INPUT_OTP_METHODS_BLUR_DESCRIPTION_: blur() removes the focus from the cells.
